job.description:
A leading Western Australian healthcare organisation is seeking a Senior Data & Insights Analyst for a newly created role with broad exposure across the business.

About the Role

This is a hands-on role where you’ll work across a range of business priorities, using data to answer questions, uncover insights and support better decision making.

Working across Finance, Operations and other areas of the business, you’ll have the opportunity to understand what sits behind the numbers and help improve how data and reporting are used across the organisation.
 
About You
 
You’re an experienced data professional with strong SQL, Power BI and analytical skills who enjoys getting into the detail and understanding the story behind the numbers.

Commercially minded and comfortable working with stakeholders, you can translate business needs into practical analysis and meaningful insights.

You’re hands-on, delivery-focused and confident taking ownership of priorities and working independently to deliver outcomes.

Healthcare experience is not essential.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Work across multiple systems and data sources, using SQL to query, analyse and investigate data.
  • Partner with Finance, Operations and SMEs to understand business processes and operational activity.
  • Analyse business performance, profitability, costs and revenue to support decision-making.
  • Develop and improve Power BI dashboards and reporting based on business needs.
  • Review existing reporting and identify opportunities to improve, consolidate or rationalise dashboards.
  • Investigate data quality, inconsistencies and gaps to improve the reliability of information.
  • Translate business questions into practical analysis and clearly communicate insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Why Apply?.
 
Join the business at an exciting stage of growth, with the opportunity to make a genuine impact.

You’ll work closely with teams across the organisation and help shape how data and reporting are used to support better business decisions.

To learn more about this opportunity, please apply or reach out to Melissa Brookes on 0461 556 064 or email melissa.brookes@aandco.au.

Opportunity to join a team where you’ll be more than just an administrator. You’ll have the chance to take ownership, build your HR capability and grow with the role.

Initially offered as a temporary position, the intention is for this role to become permanent within six months for the right person.

You’ll play a hands-on role across the employee lifecycle, supporting our people and keeping our HR processes running smoothly.

Your day-to-day will include:
  • Coordinating recruitment and onboarding
  • Preparing employment contracts and HR documentation
  • Supporting employees throughout the employee lifecycle
  • Maintaining accurate employee records and HR data
  • Managing and updating our HRIS systems
  • Supporting managers with people-related administration
  • Assisting with HR projects and process improvements
  • Looking for smarter, more efficient ways to do things
  • Taking ownership of tasks and seeing them through to completion
What we’re looking for We’re looking for someone who is switched on, organised and keen to make an impact.

You’ll bring:
  • Previous experience in HR, People & Culture or Recruitment
  • Strong systems skills and confidence learning new technology
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong organisation and time-management skills
  • Great communication skills and a confident, approachable style
  • A proactive attitude and willingness to take responsibility
  • Energy, drive and a genuine desire to grow
Most importantly, you’ll be someone who enjoys being busy, takes pride in their work and is excited by the opportunity to learn, contribute and take on more responsibility over time.


This is a great opportunity for someone who is ready to move beyond purely administrative HR work or Recruitment and build a broader career in People & Culture.

You’ll have the opportunity to:
  • Gain exposure across the full employee lifecycle
  • Develop your HR systems expertise
  • Take ownership of meaningful work
  • Work closely with managers and employees
  • Build your skills and career within a supportive environment
  • Transition into a permanent position within six months
If you’re an energetic HR professional who is systems-savvy, proactive and ready to grow, please reach out to Donna Thomas for a confidential discussion or apply via the link provided.

job.title: HR Coordinator
job.description:
We’re looking for an HR Coordinator who loves supporting people, building strong relationships and keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes.

If you’re someone who brings heart to your work, enjoys being the go‑to person for all things people‑related, and thrives in a role with plenty of variety, this could be a great fit.

In this role, you’ll be the friendly first point of contact for employee enquiries, help keep employment documentation organised and compliant, and support the full employee lifecycle — from onboarding and probation through to performance reviews, development and engagement activities.

You’ll also play a key part in coordinating training, ensuring compliance, and helping employees feel supported and connected. You’ll get involved in planning quarterly team meetings, liaising with internal stakeholders, and keeping training and development on track. 

What you’ll be doing day‑to‑day
  • Supporting employees with friendly, timely and knowledgeable HR guidance
  • Coordinating onboarding, probation check‑ins and performance review processes
  • Keeping employment records accurate, compliant and up to date
  • Managing training requirements, refresher modules and professional development activities
  • Helping deliver engagement initiatives that build connection and culture
  • Organising quarterly caregiver/team meetings and sourcing speakers
  • Supporting WHS processes including incident reporting, WorkCover and return‑to‑work
  • Providing occasional after‑hours phone support when needed
  • Pitching in across the team to help achieve shared goals
What you’ll bring
  • HR qualification or currently working towards one (highly regarded)
  • Experience in HR, recruitment or people operations
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • High attention to detail and confidence managing documentation and compliance
  • Comfortable juggling multiple priorities with a calm, organised approach
  • A proactive, ethical and people‑focused mindset
  • Solid admin skills and strong computer literacy
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively
If you’re someone who enjoys supporting others, building trust and contributing to a positive workplace culture, we’d love to hear from you.

APPLY NOW or email hannah.lelliott@aandco.au

job.title: Executive Assistant

Are you described as a perfectionist? — someone who takes genuine pride in producing accurate, polished work and ensuring nothing is missed? Please call Erin Ablitt 0451 991 529 and apply now!

job.title: Data & AI Manager
job.description:
Join an innovative AI and data Western Australian technology company at a pivotal stage of growth.  This is a leadership role where you'll own the day-to-day delivery, operations and performance of a growing Data & AI function, helping transform cutting-edge research into scalable, production-ready solutions.  As the business expands globally, you'll play a key role in shaping delivery practices, team capability and AI operations.

The Role
  • Lead the delivery, performance and development of a growing Data & AI team.
  • Drive agile ways of working, including stand-ups, sprint planning, Kanban boards and delivery reporting.
  • Own MLOps practices, model deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement across AI solutions.
  • Work closely with technical and business stakeholders to prioritise work, manage risk and ensure successful outcomes.
  • Coordinate local and offshore technical resources to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.
  • Help establish best practice across Snowflake, AWS, data pipelines, AI tooling and governance.
  • Contribute to research, innovation and the commercial application of AI technologies.
About You
  • Experience leading Data, AI, Analytics, Machine Learning or Engineering teams.
  • Strong machine learning domain expertise with experience delivering models into production.
  • Solid understanding of MLOps, cloud platforms and modern data architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Snowflake, AWS, Git, ClickUp, Jira and data pipeline tools.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and people leadership capability.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced scale-up environment where priorities evolve as the business grows.
Why Join?
  • Opportunity to influence the future direction of a rapidly scaling AI business.
  • Work with leading-edge AI, machine learning and data technologies.
  • Be part of an organisation expanding its global footprint and customer base.
  • Perth-based on-site role with occasional travel opportunities.
  • Immediate start available.
This role will suit a technically credible Data & AI leader who enjoys balancing people leadership, delivery excellence and operational execution in a high-growth environment.
